title: Pin the nudge consult's instruction text to the closed sets code owns
action: Close-door remedy: the pattern-check door flagged `pattern-20260821-instruction-text-is-an-untested-code-path` as violated for this feature, because nc-2 shipped the nudge consult entirely as prose with nothing pinning it. Add one test to packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/drivers/tests.rs, beside the advisor-line tests, modelled on control_loop.rs's `the_shipped_prompt_pins_the_record_verbs_own_closed_sets`: read skills/bee-swarming/references/worker-details.md from the repo root and assert it names the dispatch verb the lead is told to run (`bee dispatch prepare --kind advisor`, with `advisor` still present in DISPATCH_KINDS), the ADVISOR_NUDGE_KIND record that triggers it, the three poor-work signals that earn a nudge (each also present in KNOWN_SIGNALS), and the six return-form tokens (verdict:, on-track, redirect, stop, finding:, next:). The point is the tie: widen a closed set or rename the verb, and the document must learn it in the same change.

truths: The new test passes against the shipped worker-details.md.
Renaming the documented dispatch kind, or dropping a nudge signal from KNOWN_SIGNALS, makes it fail.
